title: Creamy chicken and spinach pasta

items: 1 Tbsp kosher salt (for the pasta water)
1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into ¾-inch pieces

steps: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add the 1 Tbsp salt. Cook the rigatoni until al dente. Save 1 cup of pasta water, then drain.
Meanwhile, pat the chicken dry and season with ½ tsp salt and the pepper. Heat the oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat until it shimmers.
Add the chicken in a single layer and cook 5–7 min, turning once or twice, until golden and it reads 165°F in the thickest piece.
Lower the heat to medium. Add the garlic and cook 30 sec, until fragrant. Pour in the cream, scraping up the browned bits, then stir in the parmesan. Simmer 2–3 min, until slightly thickened.
Add the spinach a handful at a time, stirring until it wilts, about 1 min.
Add the rigatoni and ¼ cup pasta water and toss until glossy and coated. Add more pasta water if it looks tight.
Taste for salt and serve sprinkled with parsley.
tips: Don't crowd the chicken. If it won't fit in one layer, brown it in two batches so it sears instead of steaming.
Boneless thighs work too and stay juicier. Cook them to 165°F the same way.
storage: Fridge up to 3 days. Reheat in a skillet over medium-low heat with a splash of milk or water until the chicken reaches 165°F. Don't freeze; the cream sauce separates.
